name: agentic-dev
description: A six-agent TDD feature-delivery pipeline (plan -> red -> green -> refactor -> document -> audit) with structural, hook-enforced per-stage scope, extracted and generalized from a working system built and dogfooded in a private Go project (KillianW/rkg). First-draft port: see docs/ROADMAP.md for what's proven vs. untested.

repo_owner.title: Repository owner
repo_owner.description: The GitHub org/user that owns the repository this plugin is installed into (e.g. "KillianW"). Substituted into agent/skill prose as ${user_config.repo_owner}.

repo_name.title: Repository name
repo_name.description: The repository's name on GitHub (e.g. "rkg"). Substituted as ${user_config.repo_name}.

default_branch.title: Default branch
default_branch.description: The branch new work branches from and ships back to.

tracker_id.title: Tracker identifier
tracker_id.description: A human-readable label for the work-item tracker this repo uses. The real operation bindings live in .claude/agentic-dev/tracker.yaml (see templates/tracker.yaml) -- this field is prose-substitution only.
